title: Palimpsity - Living Layers
description: Grow a modular city up to four levels, mix building uses and reshape its rooftops. In River Pact, connect districts with river quays, move real food and water surpluses, and prepare for a drought that halves transport capacity. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement, with Kimi implementation and Nilo review.
controls: Click: build or inspect. Drag: rotate. Right-drag: pan. Scroll: zoom.
R: rotate a building. Escape: cancel. Space: pause or resume.
Arrow keys and Enter: choose a tile and build or inspect.
English / Français: switch language without restarting.
Start River Pact: a fresh three-act scenario. Choose a charter after Act I, then keep both districts supplied through the drought on turns 120-149.
Advance 5 turns: run up to five real simulation turns and pause; stops at a choice or result. Pauses are free. Hiding the tab pauses; resume manually.
First Neighbourhood starts the earlier challenge (24 residents, 8 healthy turns, deadline 120). Classic city returns to a fresh original game.
Inspect a building to preview and confirm floors, roof changes or conversions; costs, needs and outputs are shown before spending.
Choose Banks, Works or Gardens for the building palette. Focus, camera views, photo mode and quality settings help inspect the city.
River quays unlock in phase 2. Rotate with R before placement: connect two districts to the same water basin and inspect the last-turn flows.
